en: Made artwork covers and titles open their individual detail pages, with clear View details actions across the archives.
Kept sharing in individual pages or project download dialogs and removed index sharing controls.
Highlighted the three selected works with a framed selection area, numbered seals and subtle decoration.
zh: 作品封面與標題改為進入單件詳情頁，列表加入明確的「查看詳情」入口。
分享功能集中在單件頁或單一專案下載窗口，移除列表分享按鈕。
三件精選作品加入選集外框、編號標記與細緻裝飾。

en: Made artwork covers and titles open their individual detail pages, with clear View details actions across the archives.
Kept sharing in individual pages or project download dialogs and removed index sharing controls.
Highlighted the three selected works with a framed selection area, numbered seals and subtle decoration.
zh: 作品封面與標題改為進入單件詳情頁，列表加入明確的「查看詳情」入口。
分享功能集中在單件頁或單一專案下載窗口，移除列表分享按鈕。
三件精選作品加入選集外框、編號標記與細緻裝飾。

en: Mobile SPRING / YEARN words now play once when visible and replay on tap, with reduced-motion support.
Added three selected works using the existing project descriptions, and retained the language preference across navigation and reloads.
Added individual Work and Project Files pages with share buttons, unique URLs, preview covers and summaries.
Clarified that Project Files ZIP packages include media and standalone AEP files do not.
zh: 手機 SPRING／YEARN 文字捲入畫面時播放一次，點按可重播，並支援減少動態效果。
作品集加入三件精選作品，沿用已知介紹；中英文偏好在跨頁與重新載入後保留。
作品與 Project Files 加入單件頁面、分享按鈕、獨立網址、預覽封面及簡介。
標示 Project Files 的 ZIP 包含素材、獨立 AEP 不含素材。

en: Fixed italic letter clipping during the YEARN stretch animation by allowing glyph overhang inside the word and reserving extra trailing space, while retaining the article boundary.
zh: 修正 YEARN 伸展動畫的斜體筆畫裁切：移除文字框內層裁切、增加末字預留空間，並保留介紹區塊的邊界。

en: Enlarged and darkened the memorial frame while retaining its intentional reveal condition.
Restored Project Files and Profile in the LAB desktop navigation, and Profile in Project Files.
Added contained, staggered SPRING / YEARN letter animations with reduced-motion support.
zh: 放大並加深紀念彩蛋的小線框，保留原本的特定觸發條件。
補齊 LAB 桌面導覽的 Project Files、Profile，以及 Project Files 頁的 Profile。
SPRING／YEARN 涵意區加入逐字懸停動畫，預留邊界並支援減少動態效果。

en: Brightened the shared palette with a nearly white background and softer, less saturated blue-green and leaf tones while retaining readable control text.
Concealed the memorial note behind a deliberate footer interaction on Home, Work and LAB, preserving its bilingual verses.
zh: 背景調為接近白色，藍綠與葉片色提亮並降低飽和度，控制項文字保留清楚對比。
首頁、作品與 LAB 的紀念文字改為特定頁尾互動後才出現，保留原本中英紀念詩。

en: Unified interface colors and the interactive toon logo with the supplied five-color palette: deep teal, mist blue, pale mint, cream and olive.
Redesigned the homepage Project Files entrance with an opening folder, a moving timeline and subtle Spring leaves, including mobile and reduced-motion support.
zh: 全站介面與互動三渲二 Logo 統一使用提供的五色配色：深藍綠、霧藍、淡薄荷、米白及橄欖綠。
首頁 Project Files 入口加入展開專案匣、移動時間軸與細緻的 Spring 葉片，支援手機與減少動態效果。

en: Set ratchet and blisters embedded previews to a quieter 25% initial volume while preserving manual volume changes during page interactions.
zh: ratchet 與 blisters 內嵌預覽的初始音量調為 25%，頁面互動不會重設手動調整的音量。

en: Added a compact press-and-release animation to the mobile menu open and close buttons, with reduced-motion support.
zh: 手機選單開啟與關閉按鈕加入縮放回彈、圖示輕轉的點按動畫，並支援減少動態效果。

en: Restored the Project Files desktop navigation link to the same styling as other links.
Replaced mobile header links and language switching with a shared collapsible side menu on Home, Work, LAB and Project Files.
zh: Project Files 桌面導覽連結恢復與其他連結一致的樣式。
首頁、作品、LAB 與 Project Files 的手機頂部改為共用側邊選單，收納導覽與中英文切換。

en: Highlighted the homepage Project Files entrance and added desktop/mobile top navigation.
Aligned the Project Files category controls and made AE/DaVinci buttons filter the files, with an active selection.
Simplified the bilingual contact notice.
zh: 強化首頁 Project Files 入口，加入桌面與手機頂部導覽。
修正專案檔分類按鈕對齊，AE／DaVinci 按鈕改為實際篩選並標示選取狀態。
簡化中英聯絡告示文字。

en: Added a public Project Files page with separate After Effects and DaVinci Resolve sections, seven original downloads, video previews and a contact notice.
Added Project Files entrances on Home, Work and LAB.
zh: 新增公開 Project Files 頁面，分成 After Effects 與 DaVinci Resolve，收錄七個原始專案下載、影片預覽與聯絡告示。
首頁、作品頁與 LAB 新增 Project Files 入口。

en: Added a bilingual LAB notice that most available files are currently Traditional Chinese versions.
zh: LAB 新增雙語版本語言告示，說明目前大多數檔案為繁體中文版本。

en: LAB downloads now deliver the original unencrypted ZIP after one website password check, while public build files remain encrypted.
zh: LAB 下載改為在網站輸入一次密碼後，直接取得不需密碼解壓的原始 ZIP；公開存放的版本仍保留加密保護。

en: Rewrote the bilingual 4NEVER tributes as personal words of appreciation and remembrance, with the name’s wordplay kept only in the Work verse.
zh: 4NEVER 雙語紀念文字改為更直接的欣賞、感謝與追念，名字諧音只保留在作品頁的一段。

en: Grouped same-day site updates into one daily entry with a version range and expandable complete bilingual notes.
zh: 同一天的網站更新整合為一筆日誌，顯示版本範圍並可展開完整雙語更新內容。

en: Revised the tribute poems to explicitly remember 4NEVER and his influence on my editing, with the name’s wordplay woven into the verses.
Restored a quiet 4NEVER footer marker on Home, Work and LAB.
zh: 紀念短詩明確保留對 4NEVER 的追念與剪輯啟發，將名字的諧音融入詩句。
首頁、作品頁與 LAB 頁尾入口改回低調的 4NEVER 標記。

en: Reimagined the 4NEVER tribute as a quiet 04 / infinity frame that reveals “for never...” and a different short verse on Home, Work and LAB.
Removed the memorial post link; the tribute now lives entirely in words and a small line gesture.
zh: 4NEVER 彩蛋改為低調的 04／∞ 畫格，展開「for never...」；首頁、作品頁與 LAB 各留一段短詩。
移除紀念貼文連結，以文字與細微線條留下餘光。

en: Removed the duplicate discipline selector from ALL while keeping the main work filters.
Added a quiet, expandable tribute to 4NEVER in the work archive footer.
zh: 移除 ALL 介紹區重複的分類入口，保留作品區主要分類選單。
作品頁頁尾新增低調、可展開的 4NEVER 紀念彩蛋。

en: Added work archive sorting, with dated publication records and matched source-file clues; unknown dates remain unconfirmed.
Redesigned ALL as numbered editorial plates with varied image sizes, project captions and a discipline index.
zh: 作品區新增排序功能，比對發布紀錄與原檔日期線索；未確認日期保持待考。
ALL 改為編號圖版，加入不同尺寸的作品配置、作品標題與媒介分類索引。

en: Added LAB sorting by last update, creation date, name, tool type or original order, with ascending and descending controls.
zh: LAB 新增最後更新日、建立日期、名稱、工具類型與原始順序排列，以及升序／降序切換。

en: Added project creation / latest-update date ranges and compact, dated checkpoints for all nine LAB projects.
Restored the custom cursor on checkpoint controls and added individual project sharing with direct links to authorized download dialogs.
zh: 九個 LAB 專案新增建立／最後更新日期區間與精簡、附日期的歷史 checkpoint。
修復 checkpoint 控制的專屬游標，並新增可直達授權下載視窗的個別專案分享。

en: Updated FusionDynamics2D to 0.4.1-usability with its current AES-256 encrypted build, while preserving the 0.3.5 checkpoint.
Added SY_Handwriter as the ninth LAB record with an authorized AES-256 download of the 0.3.0 Test 4 font-fitting prototype and its remaining host tests.
zh: FusionDynamics2D 更新至 0.4.1-usability 與目前的 AES-256 加密版本，保留 0.3.5 checkpoint。
新增第九筆 LAB 紀錄 SY_Handwriter，提供 0.3.0 Test 4 字型貼合原型的授權 AES-256 下載，並記錄待完成的實機測試。

en: Adjusted the historical visitor baseline to 3,280 while retaining live visitor statistics.
Added mouse / touch drag rotation, keyboard controls and reset for the 3D logo, with minimal toon shading and fine outlines.
Animated the LAB entrance leaves on hover and added a prominent confirmation button beside the download password field.
zh: 將歷史訪客基準調整為 3,280，並保留即時訪客統計。
3D logo 加入滑鼠／觸控拖曳旋轉、鍵盤操作與重設，改用極簡三渲二色階及細描邊。
LAB 入口綠葉加入懸停動畫，下載密碼輸入框旁新增清楚可見的確認按鈕。

en: Moved the LAB entrance below the work archive, with a restrained interactive card and fine-line Spring motifs.
Added a subtle interactive 3D logo from the supplied FBX in satin sage tones.
Restored visible cursors in download dialogs and repaired visitor statistics with a working service, retries and the preserved historical baseline.
zh: 將 LAB 入口移至作品區下方，加入克制的互動卡片與細線 Spring 元素。
以提供的 FBX 加入低調互動 3D logo，搭配霧面鼠尾草綠。
修復下載視窗中的游標可見性，並更換可用的訪客統計服務、加入重試與保留歷史基準值。

en: Opened authorized AES-256 ZIP downloads for five supplied Resolve / Fusion builds, including FusionDynamics2D 0.3.5-perbody.
Passwords are verified against the encrypted builds before download. Projects without a supplied build retain their development records without download buttons.
zh: 開放 5 份 Resolve／Fusion 版本的授權 AES-256 加密 ZIP 下載，包含 FusionDynamics2D 0.3.5-perbody。
下載前以加密版本驗證密碼；未提供版本的專案保留開發紀錄，不顯示下載按鈕。

en: Moved all eight Resolve / Fusion development records to a dedicated LAB / EXPERIMENTS page, with a compact homepage entry.
Added an authorized-download request flow. Online password verification and encrypted builds remain pending secure service setup.
zh: 將 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄完整移至獨立 LAB / EXPERIMENTS 頁面，首頁保留簡潔入口。
新增授權下載申請流程；線上密碼驗證與加密版本下載待安全服務設定後開放。

en: Synced the FusionDynamics2D LAB record to the latest verified 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint and its test / acceptance status.
zh: 同步 FusionDynamics2D LAB 紀錄至目前可驗證的 0.3.5-perbody checkpoint，並補充測試與驗收狀態。

en: Added LAB / EXPERIMENTS with eight Resolve and Fusion development records while preserving existing site sections.
zh: 新增 LAB / EXPERIMENTS，收錄 8 筆 Resolve／Fusion 開發紀錄，並保留既有網站區塊與功能。

en: Changed past SY / CHANGELOG entries to stay collapsed by default and expand only when requested.
zh: 將過往 SY / CHANGELOG 更新日誌改為預設隱藏，需手動展開才顯示歷史版本。

en: Added a browsable SY / CHANGELOG to preserve and review site update history.
zh: 新增可瀏覽的 SY / CHANGELOG，用來保存並回顧網站更新歷史。

en: Adjusted overview media on devices without hover support so project thumbnails display in full color by default.
zh: 調整不支援 Hover 的裝置顯示邏輯，讓作品總覽縮圖在手機等觸控裝置上預設直接顯示彩色。

en: Added Discord to the contact links at the bottom of the homepage.
zh: 在首頁底部聯繫方式新增 Discord 連結。

en: Added a historical baseline to the total visitor display while preserving live visitor growth.
zh: 為總瀏覽人數加入歷史基準值，同時保留後續真實訪客數持續累加。

en: Added the Riot Games × Rosewood Creative VALORANT Esports project to the homepage practice timeline.
zh: 在首頁創作時間線新增 Riot Games × Rosewood Creative 的 VALORANT Esports 官方專案。

en: Added a bilingual latest-update summary to the footer date interaction.
zh: 在頁尾最後更新日期加入雙語的本次更新摘要。

en: Added rolling-digit animation to the total visitor count.
zh: 讓總瀏覽人數套用與更新日期一致的數字翻動效果。

en: Added the footer last-updated date and shared visitor counter.
zh: 在頁尾新增最後更新日期與總瀏覽人數統計。

en: Expanded the Work Archive with APP / UI, 3D, drawing and editing projects.
zh: 擴充 WORK ARCHIVE，新增 APP／UI、3D、繪畫與剪輯作品。
